thread:
Marta (CS): Heads-up — Sprucewell onboarding looks healthy from adoption, but we're seeing tail latency creep on /chat during peak. Proactive idea: run an int8 compact-model canary + split routing (small % to compact-1) for 24h on a dedicated pool. Want to catch any quality regressions before renewal talks. Requesting infra + SRE help to spin the canary and an enablement touchpoint with the customer.

Leo (Infra): Can you paste the last 48h p95/qps/error numbers and the exact model name you're using now? Also which region is their traffic mostly in?

Marta (CS): Sure — metrics from our console (snapshot):
```
period: 2026-03-22 00:00 -> 2026-03-23 12:00 UTC
peak window: 17:45-18:30 UTC
endpoint: /api/chat
model: redwood-base-7b
qps: baseline 48 -> peak 110
p95 latency: 1.2s -> 1.6s
error rate: 0.3% -> 0.9%
notes: traffic primarily eu-west-1 (~72%) with smaller us-west footprint
```

Leo (Infra): OK. We can run a canary. My suggestion: start with 15% -> compact-1, 85% -> base-7b during their local evening peak. Add a health-check based rollback on latency and eval score. Jamal, can you handle KV-cache warmup and warm-start for the canary instances?

Jamal (SRE): Agree with Leo. Operational checklist:
- Run in-datacenter canary in eu-west-1
- Warm KV cache with top 50 prefixes from recent traffic
- Pre-run quality eval on a small prompt set (10-20 examples)
- Auto-rollback triggers: p95 > 2s OR error rate increase > 0.5% OR eval quality drop > 1.5%
I can own monitoring and rollback hooks. Marta, please supply the eval prompts.

Anya (AE): Renewal touchpoint in 6 weeks. If the compact route yields the expected cost delta (we estimate ~30-40% token cost savings for routing fraction) this is a strong value prop for renewal. But customer cares about latency — keep split low and highlight QA controls in the enablement call.

Marta (CS): Can we get a short (15-20m) enablement call with Sprucewell's engineering lead tomorrow at 10:00am PT? I'll share the sample prompts and screenshots of the perf dashboard. Will we have someone from infra + SRE on the call?

Leo (Infra): I can join 10:00am PT. I'll create the canary route now. CLI I'm going to use (draft):
```
retool routes create --customer sprucewell --name sprucewell-compact-canary \n  --endpoint /api/chat --models "compact-1:0.15,redwood-base-7b:0.85" \n  --region eu-west-1 --pool dedicated-eu-west-1 \n  --health-checks "p95<2000ms,error_rate_delta<0.5%,eval_score>=98" \n  --duration 24h
```
(Adjust thresholds if QA team suggests tighter limits.)

Jamal (SRE): I'll prepare the eval harness and run pre/post against the 12-sample prompt set Marta will share. Also will seed KV cache and add a short tracer to measure per-token latency distribution.

deploy-bot: Canary route 'sprucewell-compact-canary' scheduled for 2026-03-23T18:00:00Z on pool 'dedicated-eu-west-1'. Will emit rollout events to #eng-runtime and monitoring hooks to Datadog.

Marta (CS): Amazing — thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll message the customer with the plan and confirm tomorrow 10am PT. I'll post the prompt set here once it's uploaded.

Leo (Infra): LGTM. Will watch the first 2 hours closely and be ready to roll back if anything looks off.

Jamal (SRE): Ack. I'll publish the pre/post eval summary in this thread within the canary window.

Anya (AE): Adding a quick one-pager on projected cost savings + SLA caveats for the renewal deck.

Marta (CS): Perfect — keeping this thread as the single source of truth.

(quick reactions: :thumbsup: from Anya, :eyes: from Leo)
